note: The fuzzer-controlled IVF header byte selects decoder controls and steers the decode path.
The externally supplied operating point is copied into sequence-header parsing and affects which operating point idc is chosen.
The selected operating point idc is propagated into the decoder state used to filter OBUs.
The decoder must only show an existing frame when the referenced buffer has been fully initialized; this path assumes a valid, initialized frame context.
The frame context is copied and then used for entropy decoding; if the referenced state is not properly initialized, MSan reports an uninitialized read during this decode path.
